text: Program Description Clinical Pharmacy separated from the hospital Pharmacy branches of science, is based on the patient object, in order to improve the quality of Clinical medicine, for the purpose of interaction between drugs and the body as the core, research and practice rational Clinical drug application methods of comprehensive application technology subject. Future Career Clinical pharmacy graduates, the employment direction is mainly in the various medical units, medical colleges and universities engaged in clinical pharmacy education, medicine circulation, adverse drug reaction monitoring, identification and drug research and development, pharmaceutical service and management. Tuition 5 years
